chunks: Zayd al-Shahham de Abu Abdillah (la paz sea con él): En cuanto a

Un hombre que realizó el Tawaf alrededor de la Casa sin Wudu, dijo: «No hay perjuicio». Esto se entiende referido a quien realizó el Tawaf por olvido o negligencia; pero si lo hizo intencionalmente, entonces debe repetirlo. Y hemos aclarado la discusión sobre este significado en lo precedido.
ai.seo_question: Does a man need to repeat his Tawaf if he performs it without Wudu intentionally or unintentionally?
ai.summary: Zayd al-Shahham narrates from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) that Tawaf performed without Wudu is valid if the omission was due to forgetfulness or negligence, but requires repetition if intentional. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic distinction between minor ritual impurities and major ones, emphasizing that Tawaf does not strictly require the state of Wudu for validity, unlike Salah. The hadith serves as a foundational text for understanding the flexibility in ritual requirements when errors are unintentional.
